name: ielts-prep-platform
description: IELTS prep platform: React app + Express API, deployable to Vercel (with Supabase Postgres) or as one Docker container.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run migrate:deploy --prefix backend; else echo "Skipping migrations (not a production deploy)"; fi
